methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: AI Ready Roanoke evaluates use for new technology in Roanoke Valley - Roanoke Times
signals.signal_reading: AI Ready Roanoke represents organized regional effort to build local AI capacity outside major metros, signaling potential for distributed fluency if implementation moves beyond evaluation to actual skill-building.

signals.title: Some Southwest Virginia localities look to zoning to slow down data centers
signals.signal_reading: Local resistance through zoning restrictions on data centers suggests communities experiencing infrastructure imposition without capability development—physical presence of AI economy without local agency or depth.

signals.title: Amazon bows to local backlash over AI data centers, scraps plans to build four new facilities in Northern Virginia — site to be repurposed for mixed-use and residential development. - Tom's Hardware
signals.signal_reading: Amazon canceling NoVA data centers amid local backlash reveals concentration dynamics: even the established tech hub sees AI infrastructure conflicts, while capability and capital remain concentrated there despite community resistance.

signals.title: Virginia governor orders statewide plan to address AI cyberattacks - StateScoop
signals.signal_reading: Statewide defensive AI cybersecurity planning prioritizes protection over capability-building, signaling shallow platform-dependency rather than deep technical fluency across Virginia's government systems.

signals.title: News Flash Archive - NPD E911 Division implements Artificial Intelligence (AI) system on non-emergency lines - City of Norfolk (.gov)
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk's E911 AI implementation represents pragmatic platform adoption for operational efficiency—distributed deployment but shallow integration that positions government as AI consumer rather than developer of local expertise.
